notes: This file is the only description of what was changed in the vendor trees. The .patch files next to it are derived: scripts/make-patches.ps1 recomputes them, and it recomputes from_sha256/sha256/patch bytes, so those three fields are never authored by hand.

canon.eol = lf: both sides are normalized CRLF -> LF before diffing, so every .patch here is pure LF and obeys this repository's tracked-file rule; .gitattributes pins *.patch to eol=lf so a checkout cannot widen that rule into CRLF and break byte-for-byte hunk context. apply-patches.ps1 performs that normalization as a declared step, it is not hidden in the diff bytes. Measured 2026-10-29: none of the 44 CR bytes in the reference trees sits inside a string literal, and preserving them instead would cost a 338-line whole-file hunk for itk win/makefile.vc, whose upstream is CRLF and whose tree is already LF.

chains is absent when a patch applies to both build chains. Where it is present the other chain keeps the upstream bytes: rl_json win/makefile.vc and itk win/makefile.vc + win/rules.vc are msvc-only, verified 2026-10-29 against the unpacked pristine tree.

rename_token is an invariant operation, not a patch: it renames a whole-word identifier everywhere in the file. It is declared separately because the 256 occurrences of the C keyword finally would otherwise occupy 1931 diff lines that all say the same thing. make-patches.ps1 applies rename_token first and diffs only the residue, so the patch next to it is what a reviewer actually has to read. matches/remaining are asserted, not documented: a mismatch fails the run.
file paths are relative to the vendor tree named by component in scripts/vendor-layout.json, which supplies the destination directory; nothing here repeats it.

Scope of this manifest: source edits only. Three things that alter a build deliberately stay outside it because they are properties of the build, not of the vendor source - the dyncall .lib substitution in the twapi tree (scripts/build-msvc-ext.bat L17-20, scripts/build-mingw-ext.sh L19-22), the rl_jsonUuid.h / manifest.uuid seeding (scripts/build-msvc-ext2.bat L14-40, scripts/build-mingw-ext2.sh L13-29), and the two derived junctions under build/msvc/ext. All three are indexed in patches/README.md.

from_sha256 is the hash of the pristine file after CRLF->LF normalization, i.e. the input rename_token and the patch expect. sha256 is the hash of the expected result, measured from the tree the kit was built and tested from. apply-patches.ps1 verifies both, so a patch that applies cleanly but produces the wrong bytes still fails.

itk несёт rules.vc 1.19 без targets.vc → U1052; переименование включает fallback на tcl'овский rules.vc 1.16. Содержимое байт-в-байт апстримное, поэтому это не дифф, а операция переименования: в дереве msvc есть rules.vc.own и нет rules.vc, в mingw наоборот
DllMain обёрнут в #ifndef STATIC_BUILD: в статическом ките DllMain уже определяет twapi → LNK2005. thisModule остаётся NULL, что для кита корректно (GetModuleFileNameA(NULL) возвращает путь exe)

два case $x in { → switch -- $x { в ezPaperInfo (размеры бумаги + ориентация). Каскад: canvasprintbox 31 F, canvasprintdialog 52 F, usual c3/c4
flash теперь явно return: в Tk 9 button flash оставляет в результате имя индикаторного изображения, а документированный результат метода — пустая строка

I9/portability: portable runtime не читает ~/.tcllinerc и не читает/пишет ~/.tclline_history (untrusted home profile). В proc TclReadLine::interact закомментированы source $RCFILE и чтение из $HISTFILE; в proc TclReadLine::doExit закомментирована запись истории от exec stty sane до close $f, exit $code оставлен
